CHM1032.title: General Chemistry for Science Allied Fields (One Semester): Chemistry for Health Sciences
CHM1032.prerequisites: None statewide; no prior chemistry assumed. Carriers set a math gate: UCF a C in MAC1105C or MGF1130; Gulf Coast math placement or a C in college math; Palm Beach and Indian River college-level placement. *** NOT A SUBSTITUTE FOR CHM2045 (the state says so): pharmacy, PA, medicine, dentistry, most dietetics and science majors need CHM2045/2046. Check your target programme before registering. *** NOT GE CORE: whether it counts as natural-science gen ed is each college's call (not at CF or IRSC). *** LAB IS SEPARATE (CHM1032L) at most carriers. *** Indian River carries this number at 1 CREDIT (biochemistry only); everyone else at 3.

offering_notes.summary: Ten public carriers. Nine at 3 credits; Indian River at 1 credit (biochemistry only). FIU still appears in the state file but its own catalogue marks the course inactive. Broward publishes 48 lecture hours, Gulf Coast 3 lecture hours a week.
offering_notes.derivation: Florida convention: 45 hours for a 3-credit lecture course. Broward publishes 48; Gulf Coast publishes 3 lecture hours a week. No other carrier publishes hours.
